verdict.rationale: Dark mode and night-light settings are a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions dark mode, Night Shift, or any display-warmth or eye-strain setting. The pack covers only Continuity, Siri, Safari, passwords and community threads about bugs and performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can switch to dark mode or enable a night light to reduce eye strain
